commands.summary: Backend TypeScript build passed with the new fax.ts module and the fax types/methods/migration added to database.ts and channels.ts.

commands.command: cd Electron && node --test backend-dist/fax.test.js backend-dist/database.test.js backend-dist/channels.test.js
commands.summary: 72 tests passed: 8 new pure state-machine tests (fax.test.js), 11 new fax persistence tests (database.test.js: fresh schema, v28->v29 migration with data preservation, forward-version rejection, create/reload, document linkage, direction round-trip, legal/illegal/terminal transitions, event dedup and out-of-order non-regression, creation/submission idempotency, ambiguous-state recovery), plus all pre-existing database/channels tests unchanged.

Full suite: 261 node:test cases, 260 passed, 1 skipped (opt-in live Twilio test, unrelated), 0 failed; vitest App.test.tsx (228 cases) and npm run renderer:build also passed as part of the same script. No Telnyx network call occurred anywhere in this phase.
RepoPact 2.2.0 validation, LIE-003 schema-ladder invariants, and markdown link/last_verified checks all passed after the WI041 ledger updates.

environment.process_note: WI041 Phase 1: provider-neutral fax domain (FaxDirection/FaxProvenance/FaxState/FaxDocumentRef/FaxRequest/FaxResult/FaxStatusUpdate/InboundFax/FaxProvider in fax.ts, deliberately not a ChannelAdapter), a sealed 14-state lifecycle state machine with an explicit ambiguous outbound state and duplicate/illegal-transition rejection independent of event arrival order, and durable persistence (faxes/fax_documents/fax_events, schema v28->v29) with idempotent creation and state-guarded transitions as ForgeLink's own outbound-operation-identity seam. No Telnyx adapter, credential validation, webhook route, provider media handling, HTTP endpoint, UI, MCP tools, communication-firewall wiring, or Tauri integration were implemented in this phase; FAX-002 and FAX-003 were marked satisfied at the time of this run, then reopened to pending during the Phase 1.1 architectural review (see evidence 20260910-fax-phase1-1-hardening-correction) because the review found the inbound-initialization and out-of-order-convergence gaps this record did not yet account for. FAX-001 and FAX-004 through FAX-016 remain pending. Synthetic phone numbers and synthetic document references only; no credentials, no real fax content, no network calls.
